description: This Java source file defines the PojoWrapper class, which is part of a code generation framework. The class acts as a wrapper for a CustomVariable, representing a Plain Old Java Object (POJO) and manages its dependencies such as enums, events, and other POJOs within a code generation process.

classes.name: PojoWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class representing a POJO variable which manages dependencies like enums, events, and other POJOs.

methods.name: PojoWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with a CustomVariable and prepares the POJO section.

methods.name: getVarName
methods.description: Returns the variable name of the POJO, matching the CustomVariable's name.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Returns the CustomVariable object that this wrapper represents.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the dependencies (other wrappers) that this POJO depends on.

methods.name: buildDependencies
methods.description: Analyzes the CustomVariable to identify and register dependencies such as enums, events, nested POJOs, and arrays.

methods.name: checkDependency
methods.description: Checks and adds dependencies for a given variable, handling different variable types accordingly.

methods.name: addDependency
methods.description: Adds a wrapper as a dependency to this POJO and ensures the dependency has consistent language settings.
